description: React component for a Sign-In pane with form handling, state management, and external dependencies.

classes.name: SignInPane
classes.description: React functional component for user sign-in interface with form controls and logic.

methods.name: resetInvalid
methods.description: Resets error state if any error message exists.

methods.name: handleEmailChange
methods.description: Updates email state on input change.

methods.name: handlePasswordChange
methods.description: Updates password state and clears error on input change.

methods.name: onRecoveryCodesChange
methods.description: Handles recovery codes sign-in toggle and sets recovery codes.

methods.name: signIn
methods.description: Performs sign-in with email and password, handles response and errors.

methods.name: recoverySignIn
methods.description: Performs sign-in using recovery codes, handles response and errors.

methods.name: onPrivateUsernameChange
methods.description: Handles private username mode toggle and sets email if applicable.

methods.name: handleSignInFormSubmit
methods.description: Handles form submission, triggers sign-in or recovery sign-in.

methods.name: handleKeyDown
methods.description: Handles key down events, triggers form submit on Enter.
